# stb_image 2.30 and stb_image_write 1.16 (vendored)

`stb_image.h`, `stb_image_write.h` and `LICENSE` of
https://github.com/nothings/stb at commit d14d46f, unchanged
(MIT OR Unlicense, the author's choice).

- Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nothings/stb/d14d46f/<file>
- SHA-256 of `stb_image.h`: 594c2fe35d49488b4382dbfaec8f98366defca819d916ac95becf3e75f4200b3
- SHA-256 of `stb_image_write.h`: cbd5f0ad7a9cf4468affb36354a1d2338034f2c12473cf1a8e32053cb6914a05
- SHA-256 of `LICENSE`: bebfe904b14301657e4e5d655c811d51fd31b97c455b9cc2d8600d6bac6cff63

stb_image decodes the floor plan images (IND-02, spec 16.2) in
`core/src/plan/stb_image_impl.c`; stb_image_write writes the image
fixtures of the tests (`tests/plan/fixtures/`).
